# `scope_set_slew_rate`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Select the mount slew-rate index.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build matches (READ)) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, guider handler @0x72200 (64-bit build) |

Requires a connected mount that supports the operation, then selects the slew-rate index used by subsequent moves. The parameter is a bare integer or an array whose first element is an integer; a non-integer gives 104. The handler applies no list bound, clamp or default; the supported index list and whether the rate is sent to hardware immediately are unresolved. Via the imager command port (4700) the request reaches this handler only as a forwarded unknown method; see the control service for the relay. No serial traffic (firmware 9.31, READ): the rate is stored in the driver and sent as a rate command at the next move.

Side effects: Changes the cached slew-rate selection used by motion commands.
